import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Setup paths
DATA_PATH = "./input"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_PATH, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_PATH, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_PATH, "test.csv"))

# Label Encoding
label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_df["label"] = train_df["author"].map(label_map)

# Train-Validation Split (Hold-out)
# Ensure no data leakage by splitting rows before feature extraction
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["text"].values, train_df["label"].values, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Feature Extraction
# Base solution settings preserved: character ngram (2,5), word ngram (1,3), max_df=0.9
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 5), min_df=2, max_df=0.9, sublinear_tf=True
)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.9, sublinear_tf=True
)

X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val_raw)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_raw)

# Concatenate features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_char.toarray(), X_train_word.toarray()])
X_val = np.hstack([X_val_char.toarray(), X_val_word.toarray()])

# IMPROVEMENT: Ensemble of 3 LogisticRegression models with different random states
# This reduces variance and improves generalization without changing feature architecture
n_models = 3
ensemble_val_preds = np.zeros((len(X_val), 3))

start_time = time.time()
for i in range(n_models):
    model = LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=1000, random_state=i, C=10, class_weight="balanced"
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    preds = np.clip(preds, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    ensemble_val_preds += preds

ensemble_val_preds /= n_models

# Validation Metric Calculation
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, ensemble_val_preds)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Test Predictions
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_char.toarray(), X_test_word.toarray()])

test_preds = np.zeros((len(test_df), 3))

for i in range(n_models):
    model = LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=1000, random_state=i, C=10, class_weight="balanced"
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)
    preds = np.clip(preds, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    test_preds += preds

test_preds /= n_models

# Create Submission
submission = test_df[["id"]].copy()
submission["EAP"] = test_preds[:, 0]
submission["HPL"] = test_preds[:, 1]
submission["MWS"] = test_preds[:, 2]

# Save Submission to ./submission/submission.csv
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_PATH, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print(f"Submission saved with {len(submission)} rows to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total runtime: {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
